# openloops

> An open source harness for building multitenant AI agents for your SaaS: a TypeScript runtime that runs in your backend. It persists chats, tasks and tool calls in MongoDB, scopes everything to a user, asks for approval before destructive tools and unapproved MCP servers, and can run agents on a schedule. It has no HTTP layer: your backend calls its use cases and owns authorization.

Start with the integration guide, then read only the pages you need. All pages are in this folder.

## Start here

- [Integration guide](integration-guide.md): what to write in a backend, which endpoint calls what, and the security checklist
- [Authorization](authorization.md): the scope that every use case uses to check who owns a record, and how to migrate from 0.5
- [README](../README.md): what it is, the quick start and the package structure

## Run an agent

- [The Agent](agent.md): options, running a turn, statuses, confirmations, autonomous mode
- [Configuration](configuration.md): environment variables, default model, timeouts
- [Reporting errors](error-reporting.md): `setErrorReporter`, what it receives, what is reported, serverless and moving from `SENTRY_DSN`
- [Chats](chats.md): the chat record, its title, message source, listing, searching and deleting, and the migration to 0.8.0

## Shape the agent
